items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: He was a saxophone player, but he wasn't playing with us. He used to arrange for us, you see.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well Caesar was on saxophone and arranging both, huh? Well he wasn't playing with us.

He was a saxophone player, but he wasn't playing with us. He used to arrange for us, you see. We'd ring them bells and there were several good numbers we bought. He used to play with the trombone. Who was playing trombone? Eddie Pearson. I know you know him. Oh yeah. But he was another guy who helped me to get into Sonny South. He was playing, I forgot to tell you about the trombone, but he was playing trombone in the Sonny South.
